_comment: ReverseTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's own mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Your symbol is '{symbol}'.
The goal is to avoid getting three in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally).
If you make three in a row, you LOSE.
Submit your move using the format '[4]' to place your symbol in cell 4.
As Player {player_id}, you are '{symbol}' and your opponent is '{opponent_symbol}'.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} placed their symbol ({symbol}) in cell {cell}.

outcome.lose: Player {player_id} loses by completing a line!
outcome.draw: It's a draw! No one lost.
